newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Education Minister Francois Bayrou unveils plan to reform university and higher education systems.
-- A Paribas report on Credit Foncier is not as negative to the property lender's management as previously assumed.

Paribas reportly said CFF lender's business plan relies on ambitious hypotheses for turnover, long-term interest rates forecasts, and the timing of layoffs. Added that if one of these conditions were not met, the state may have to recapitalise massively. This conclusion has been used by Finance Minister Jean Arthuis to justify a planned dismantling of Credit Foncier, the paper adds.
-- French firms do not take advantage of the rise in share prices to issue new share, due to rate cuts which make debt a relatively cheap alternative.
-- French new car sales plunged 33.6 percent in January.
-- White-collar workers no longer hesitate to engage in labour unrest as downsizing hits them, survey shows.
